concepts.reader_question: Trước khi nối: rõ ranh giới chưa?
concepts.description: An architectural overview shows two system domains separated by a visible physical boundary before a connection is designed. Use credible semiconductor material depth and integrated neutral diagrams. All background records blank; no microglyphs, data, IDs, dates, metrics, ticks, seals, fabricated results or added labels. Print only exact approved artwork and official mark once.
